LibTmux.Query.ServerInfo

Description

Captured daemon metadata for LibTmux.Query.

The tmux 3.3a baseline supplies one ServerInfo per complete snapshot. PID and start time are diagnostics, not a replacement for generation-bound references or proof of present liveness.
